title: Fix admin panel button visibility in production

requirements.text: Debug and fix the admin button not appearing in the Navbar component on the deployed web version. The button should be visible to authenticated admin users in the header navigation.

quotes: the admin panel is still not appearing on web

acceptanceCriteria: Admin button is visible in the header navigation when logged in as an admin user
Admin button correctly links to the admin panel
Admin button is hidden for non-admin users
Button displays consistently across desktop and mobile viewports

requirements.text: Verify that the useCallerRole hook correctly identifies admin users in the production environment and returns the proper admin status.
acceptanceCriteria: useCallerRole hook successfully fetches admin status from backend
Hook handles loading and error states appropriately
Admin status is cached correctly with 5-minute TTL
Hook works consistently in development and production environments

requirements.text: Ensure the backend isCallerAdmin method correctly identifies admin principals and returns the appropriate boolean value.
acceptanceCriteria: isCallerAdmin method correctly checks caller principal against admin list
Method returns true for authenticated admin users
Method returns false for non-admin users
Admin principal validation works in production deployment

constraints: Do not modify the existing authentication flow using Internet Identity
Maintain the current admin access control architecture
Preserve existing Navbar component functionality for non-admin features
nonGoals: Adding new admin features or pages
Changing the visual design of the admin button
Modifying the admin panel content management features
